item.title: Correction · Strata at Mission Bay: Insomnia Cookies at 1215 4th St is still shown as open, but no readable page confirms it. DataSF lists two registrations by the same owner: 1215 4th St from February 2022 with no end date, and 1201 4th St from December 2021 to September 17, 2025. A registration does not show a storefront operating, and the 2025 end date could mean a closure or an address change.

item.title: Correction · Strata at Mission Bay: Strata's map notes called it a 5-story building; OSM, the DBI permit and the Assessor all say 8 stories. The March 2009 completion date rested on SocketSite's forecast that units would come online then (a later SocketSite piece said move-ins had 'a long way to go'); it now cites DBI's permit completed 2009-07-15 and the Assessor's year built 2009 and says no source confirms move-in. Teappo was listed as an open tenant at 1225 4th St Unit 616, but its website is an online store with no storefront and 1225 4th St is The UPS Store's address, so it was removed from the tenant list and its earlier entry now says it is not a confirmed tenant. The One Medical and UPS Store entries now say their link to Strata comes from geocoding a business registration, not from the cited page. Insomnia Cookies could not be re-checked (Yelp blocks automated fetches) and is noted as unconfirmed. The Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural.

item.title: Added · Strata at Mission Bay: Teappo (shopteappo.com) is an online store with no street address or storefront on its site. A business registration lists it at 1225 4th St Unit 616, which is the address of The UPS Store #6609 (registrations there use unit/PMB numbers), so no storefront is shown and Teappo is not a confirmed tenant of Strata at Mission Bay.

item.title: Complete · Strata at Mission Bay: DBI recorded the construction permit (8 stories, 192 dwelling units) complete on 2009-07-15, and the Assessor gives 2009 as the year built. SocketSite had forecast in January 2009 that the rental units would come online that March and published a reader's report on February 3, 2009 that first move-ins were scheduled for March 1 but had 'a long way to go'; no source read confirms when tenants moved in. (Jul 15, 2009)
